title: Redwood February 2025 All-Hands
topics: Product roadmap highlights: Dedicated, Private, Optimize
summary: Company all-hands covering Q4 results, Q1 priorities, product milestones for Dedicated and Private, Optimize updates, hiring plan and a short security/compliance briefing. Leadership answered questions on roadmap timing, pricing and customer expansion. Action items assigned for follow-ups and docs to be shared.
next_steps: Sofia to share Q1 goals slide deck (by 2025-02-14)
Tom to publish performance benchmark summary (by 2025-02-20)
Aisha to open forum thread on roadmap prioritization (by 2025-02-15)
People ops to circulate hiring plan and referral incentives (by 2025-02-18)
action_items: Tom Bennett: Compile Dedicated capacity perf spreadsheet and share with eng@redwood (due 2025-02-20)
Aisha Rahman: Draft customer-facing roadmap bullet points for marketing review (due 2025-02-17)
Grace Kim: Post hiring plan + interview panel schedule to #hiring (due 2025-02-18)
Sofia Liu: Share leadership Q&A summary and slides (due 2025-02-14)
transcript:
[00:00:00] Sofia Liu: Good afternoon everyone, welcome to the Feb 2025 all hands, we're at about 16:00 UTC, thanks for joining. Uh quick housekeeping — the recording will be up in approx 30 mins, slides are in the all-hands deck link in chat.
[00:00:28] Carlos Ortega: Quick note on time, we got 55 minutes, we'll do updates then Q&A.
[00:00:35] Sofia Liu: Alright we'll kick off with numbers. Briefly Q4 closed in line with the commit, ARR growth 42% year over year, net retention 112% — lots of credit to sales and big thank you. A couple things to call out: Dedicated bookings accelerated in late Dec, and Private pilot deals are moving to legal.
[00:01:05] Tom Bennett: On the engineering side, shipment cadence was steady, we completed the new scheduler for batching which has cut token cost by roughly 18% in our internal runs, still more tuning. Note some of our numbers are still preliminary — perf runs had noise because of infra churn.
[00:01:28] Speaker 1: (sigh) that's awesome, when do we expect this hitting prod?
[00:01:34] Tom Bennett: We're on track for canary next week, full rollout late March if no regressions. There's an optional toggle for per-route batching.
[00:01:48] Aisha Rahman: Product highlight — Redwood Optimize beta is in 30 customers now, early signal shows 12-25% cost savings depending on workload; it's suggesting quantization profiles + cache policies aligned to route. We'll start a broader beta invite list next month.
[00:02:12] Sofia Liu: Quick shoutouts — Eng did a huge push on reliability during the region deploys, CS had five wins last quarter for Dedicated deals.
[00:02:23] Grace Kim: Hiring update — we closed 8 IC hires last month, ramping interviews for mid-senior backend and infra. Reminder about referral bonuses, pls post in #hiring.
[00:02:38] [00:03:00] Carlos Ortega: Security/compliance — we achieved SOC 2 Type II readiness for our hosted control plane, and the Private offering now supports bring-your-own KMS + HSM integration in the latest build for on-prem. There's a note: audit logs retention default is 90 days, enterprise can request extended retention.
[00:03:25] Sofia Liu: On go-to-market — our PLG motion is paying off, free-tier conversion improved and our marketing team is doing great. Also partnerships: a channel pilot with an APAC partner is live.
[00:03:40] Tom Bennett: Tech deep dive highlight: the new KV cache invalidation semantics reduce duplicate decoding for long context flows, that helped latency on our internal LLMs. But caveat — some open-model variants need re-quantization to match perf.
[00:04:05] Speaker 2: Someone asked in chat about cost tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Hosted?
[00:04:10] Aisha Rahman: Good q — Dedicated gives predictable throughput and can be more economical at scale due to reserved capacity; hosted is fastest to trial and for smaller bursty workloads. Private is for regulatory/data residency needs. We'll publish a decision matrix to help Customers choose.
[00:04:35] Sofia Liu: I'd add that model variant routing and automatic fallback are part of our reliability story — so even if a specific GPU type is at capacity, requests can be routed to a compatible variant.
[00:04:49] [00:05:00] Carlos Ortega: Brief note on hardware partnerships: we're testing Ampere next-gen boards with a partner, early signals show improved throughput for quantized int8 kernels. There was one misreport earlier where a benchmark used wrong sequence length, we re-ran and updated the sheet.
[00:05:25] Speaker 3: Are we still seeing noisy neighbor issues on shared pools?
[00:05:29] Tom Bennett: Less so, the autoscaler improvements plus smarter packing helped. We also tuned the scheduler to be more conservative on long-running KV cache heavy flows.
[00:05:45] Sofia Liu: Ok product roadmap quick look — three focus areas for Q1: 1) Dedicated capacity scale & SLA improvements, 2) Private deployment GA readiness including KMS/HSM and auditing, 3) Optimize feature set expansion (batching suggestions, model recommendations).
[00:06:10] Aisha Rahman: Timeline: Dedicated scale improvements targeted Mar release, Private GA targeted end of Q1 with a soft pilot in early March, Optimize broader beta in late March. These are still mar/quarter targets, so treat as guidance not a promise.
[00:06:30] [00:07:00] Speaker 4: (mumble) any update on pricing for Dedicated?
[00:07:05] Sofia Liu: Pricing conversation is ongoing; sales is testing a two tier for reserved capacity — base commit and burst. We'll share a pricing FAQ for the field next week.
[00:07:18] Aisha Rahman: Also working on per-route cost estimation so customers can see projected token spend by route in the console.
[00:07:33] Carlos Ortega: On reliability metrics — mean latency is down 10% across the main routes after the scheduler change in beta, p95 saw the biggest improvement. We're still tracking tail latency for long context sessions.
[00:07:50] [00:08:30] Sofia Liu: People question — burn and runway. Finance recap: runway extended by roughly 9 months after the Series C close and recent cost optimizations. We are prioritizing headcount in infra and sales to support growth.
[00:08:58] Grace Kim: On org changes — promoting two ICs to staff, and a new director hire in sales to lead enterprise motion. We'll update the org chart in the wiki.
[00:09:20] Speaker 5: (interrupt) can we get an onboarding checklist for new hires?
[00:09:23] Grace Kim: Yes, we'll post a refreshed onboarding playbook and pair programs.
[00:09:35] [00:10:00] Sofia Liu: Q&A time. Please use raise hand or post in Q&A. First q — what's the customer success play for Dedicated expansions?
[00:10:12] Tom Bennett: CS and SE will run joint QBRs for customers with reserved capacity; we plan proactive perf tuning and quarterly architecture reviews.
[00:10:25] Aisha Rahman: For pilots moving to legal, we streamline checklists: security questionnaire, SLA scoping, data processing addendum. This reduced time to close in a few pilots.
[00:10:40] Speaker 6: Any larger enterprise deals in pipeline?
[00:10:45] Sofia Liu: Yes a couple of mid-market to enterprise deals — can't share names now but these are for Dedicated + Private legal discussions.
[00:10:52] [00:11:30] Carlos Ortega: A quick technical note — some customers reported oddness with model tool-calling in early SDK; we've patched the binding and will cut an SDK patch release. Please route reported issues to #sdk-bugs.
[00:11:48] Speaker 7: (from chat) roadmap ask — can we surface more of the infra telemetry in console?
[00:11:53] Tom Bennett: Yes that's planned; incremental telemetry is coming to console as observability add-ons. We'll prioritize based on enterprise requests.
[00:12:15] [00:12:45] Aisha Rahman: Marketing note — show three case studies next month focused on Dedicated wins: latency improvements, cost predictability, private deployments. If you worked on these please ping marketing.
[00:12:58] Sofia Liu: All hands also means culture. We had a great offsite and hack week, lots of cross-team projects. Keep flagging ideas for future hack themes.
[00:13:12] Grace Kim: Reminder about the pulse survey going out; please take 5 minutes, will help with remote work policy adjustments.
[00:13:30] [00:14:00] Speaker 8: (inaudible) are we open to external benchmarks publication?
[00:14:05] Carlos Ortega: We are but it's gated — need to ensure reproducibility and we must avoid disclosing customer telemetry. We'll publish curated benchmarks with methodology.
[00:14:20] Speaker 9: Any news on regional expansion?
[00:14:24] Sofia Liu: Planning for additional cloud regions in APAC later this year; initial partner pilot live.
[00:14:36] [00:15:00] Tom Bennett: Tech ops note: maintenance window next Sunday, expect brief console downtime for infra upgrades. We'll post exact times.
[00:15:12] Speaker 10: How's the model catalog curation going?
[00:15:18] Aisha Rahman: Model catalog now lists verified perf profiles, compatibility notes for quantized variants, and recommended route presets. Still refining naming — sometimes acronyms get mis-tagged in the catalog.
[00:15:40] [00:16:00] Sofia Liu: Ok moving to lightning updates from teams — Growth, Product, Eng, CS — 1 minute each. Growth first.
[00:16:10] Speaker 11 (Growth): Growth — signup conversion up 8%, free-tier to paid improved after onboarding flows. Testing new in-app trial prompts.
[00:16:30] Speaker 12 (Product): Product — shipping better telemetry, new canary flags for batching.
[00:16:45] Speaker 13 (Eng): Eng — rolled out the new scheduler to beta; debugging some edge cases on long-context flows.
[00:17:00] Speaker 14 (CS): CS — pilot to customer handoffs improved with new playbook; we'll share playbook link soon.
[00:17:20] [00:18:00] Sofia Liu: Closing thoughts — focus on reliability, customer expansion, and disciplined product launches. Please prioritize quality over speed on major infra changes.
[00:18:20] Aisha Rahman: One more note on docs: we'll publish clearer decision matrices for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private and sample architecture diagrams.
[00:18:35] [00:19:00] Sofia Liu: Ok final Q&A. (long pause) nothing major in the queue, thanks everyone. Recap of action items and who owns them is in the notes; we'll post slides and recording.
[00:19:22] Grace Kim: Thank you all, small team updates in the next 24 hours.
[00:19:30] Sofia Liu: Meeting adjourned.

Notes on transcription: occasional mis-heard words and speaker tags may be off, timestamps approximate. Links shared in chat: all-hands deck (link), perf spreadsheet (link), hiring doc (link).
